We totally get needing to watch the budget – been there. If money’s a bit tight but you still want a Chilly’s, you’ve got a couple of flexible ways to pay:
Klarna (orders over £60)
Pay in 3: split your order into 3 equal instalments – first at checkout, then at 30 and 60 days, no interest when paid on time.
Pay in 30 days: get your order now, pay the full amount 30 days later, also interest-free when paid on time.
Regular payment methods
Cards via Shop Pay: Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, Diners Club, Discover, Maestro, Union Pay (Japan only).
Wallets: Apple Pay and Google Pay.
Local options: Bancontact (Belgium) and iDeal (Netherlands).
Do keep in mind: Klarna’s Pay in 3 and Pay in 30 days are unregulated credit agreements, and borrowing more than you can afford or missing payments can affect your financial status and ability to get credit in future. You also need to be 18+ and a UK resident, and late fees may apply if you don’t pay on time.
So, if you’re trying to stretch your budget, Klarna can help spread the cost, while cards and wallets work best if you’re paying everything upfront.
